profile.headline: Sofware Engineer
profile.summary:
I've been working for 4+ years developing software, creating new tools, updating applications, merging and documenting projects. Many times working in high stressing environments that require quick thinking and results, but that's just one day more at work. I also have high interested and data mining and machine learning in which I focused my MS studies at George Washington University.

I love the creativity in the process of creating something that's unknown. And learning something new every day.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Participated in all aspects of the Agile SDLC to deliver an enterprise-grade, single-page web application modeling the current and future state of United States corporate tax reform
• Designed and developed reusable front-end components using JavaScript, AngularJS, CSS, HTML5, and Bootstrap
• Developed responsive, interactive data visualizations showing application-calculated tax impact output values allowing users to see the direct impact of their input data
• Developed dynamic AngularJS/HTML input forms representing corporate tax forms with data validation and real-time linking to dashboard visualizations
• Integrated with Java-based RESTful web services deployed in a microservice architecture in on-premise and Azure web farms
• Management of a SQL server database integrity through the different iterations of the application.

positions.title: Java Developer Semi Senior Advanced
positions.description:
• Fixed bugs and developed the internalization module for the web application “StarMeUp” using JavaScript (JQuery, underscore, require and i18n). 
• Migrated web-services from Mule to SOAP using Spring 3.1 and including a personalized security layer for Southwest Airlanes. Also converted a large application from Maven to Gradle. And developed a manager for the Spring-Cron-Module of it. We worked with SCRUM methodology and JIRA.

positions.title: Research and Development Analyst
positions.description:
• Maintenance using Java, Struts 1.0, Oracle database and C++ of PMT2 (project of technology modernization) with the National Civil Registry. A large distributed application for the creation and management of IDs in Colombia.
• Developed an enhancement for the signature crop process for IDs of people less than 18 years old. Improved the process in 90%.

positions.title: Junior Engineer
positions.description:
• Web-page development using Java, EJB 3.1, Oracle Glassfish 3.1.2.2, SQL Server database and primefaces for a banking web application that manage the creation and management of products(credits, guarantees and incentives) of FINAGRO (Fund for Agricultural Financing.).
• Use cases analysis and implementation design using UML diagrams (sequence and components).

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Development in Java and icefaces on SecureFile MFT product, an application which allows automatize and secure the transfer processes of files using transfer standards and cryptography.
• Encryption and decryption management using PGP (Pretty Good Privacy) and JKS (Java KeyStore).
• Researching and continuation of the development of the encryption and decryption module of ECC(Elliptic curve cryptography) for SecureFile MFT.
